sys_script_fix.description: v0.6 (O05): copies per-instance plugin CIs to plain tracked items and verifies; never deletes. Idempotent.
sys_script_fix.name: Driftwood - Move plugins to plain record
sys_script_fix.script: /* Driftwood - Move plugins to plain records (v0.6, O05) * Copies every per-instance plugin record stored as a CI to the plain * tracked_item table (first seen, last changed, presence, links and the * tracked object are kept). Idempotent; it never deletes the CIs. When it * reports SAFE TO DELETE, delete them with "Delete All Records" on the * x_2160899_driftw_0_cmdb_ci_sn_tracked_plugin table. On an instance that never * stored plugins as CIs it does nothing. * * Dry run first: Scripts - Background, script scope Driftwood: * gs.info(new ConfigNowMigration().movePlugins({ dryRun: true }).text); */ gs.info(new ConfigNowMigration().movePlugins().text);
sys_script_fix.sys_name: Driftwood - Move plugins to plain record
